task: FastAPI endpoint /api/tick/query for DolphinDB tickDB snapshots
summary: Wrote schema (TickQuerySingleRequest/Response), service method (query_tick_single), and router endpoint (/api/tick/query) that queries dfs://tickDB/snapshots by stock_code and date range using DolphinDB connection pool. Validated inputs with validate_ukey and to_dolphindb_date, applied partition pruning via trade_date filter, and handled empty results safely.
approach: Read existing project routers/tick.py, services/tick_service.py, dolphindb_pool.py, schemas/tick.py, and validators.py to match existing code style. Produced minimal additions to each layer rather than standalone files.
